title: Action Roll / Duality Dice
body: Roll two d12s, one Hope die and one Fear die. Add the fitting trait and any bonuses, then compare the total to the Difficulty.
Higher Hope die means with Hope. Higher Fear die means with Fear. Matching dice are a Critical Success.
Reaction rolls use the same dice structure but do not generate Hope/Fear or GM moves.

rows: Success with Hope: succeed and gain Hope; add generosity or clean position.
Success with Fear: succeed, but the GM gains Fear and makes the cost bite.
Failure with Hope: miss the goal, but gain Hope and a useful thread.
Failure with Fear: fail and the GM makes a hard move that follows from the fiction.
Critical Success: best case, gain Hope, clear 1 Stress, and add a small gift.

title: Slider Outcomes
body: Kyle's Slider System adds degree to the Daggerheart result. It is a house layer, not official rules text.
First read total against the hinge D. Then overlay Hope/Fear spin. Crit always takes the top outcome.

rows: Failure with a partial thread or near miss.
Top outcome, gain Hope, clear 1 Stress, small gift.
Legendary attempt; usually offer another route.
Sprint, leap, maneuver, dodge, balance, climb fast, keep footing.
Lift, smash, grapple, hold, carry, resist force, endure strain.
Control, hide, tinker, pick, disable, handle delicate details.
Perceive, sense, navigate, track, read danger, read animals.
Charm, lead, soothe, deceive, perform, intimidate, negotiate.
Recall, analyze, investigate, comprehend, reason from lore.

title: Advantage, Disadvantage, Help, Experiences
body: Advantage adds a d6. Disadvantage subtracts a d6. They cancel one-for-one.
Help an Ally: an ally spends 1 Hope, rolls a d6, and adds it to the acting PC's roll.
Spend 1 Hope on a relevant Experience to add +2. Tag Team rolls cost 3 Hope and let two PCs act together.

title: GM Fear Economy and Fear Spends
body: GM starts with 1 Fear per PC and can hold up to 12 Fear.
Spend Fear to seize spotlight, make an extra move, spotlight extra adversaries, add adversary Experience, trigger Fear Features, advance countdowns, or reveal cost.
P2P Jenga Fear variant: with Fear means pull a numbered tower block. Block color is narrative corporate attention. Collapse fires banked consequences.

title: Adversary Attacks, Damage, Armor, Stress
body: No fixed initiative. Pass spotlight by danger, intent, and consequences.
Adversary attacks roll d20 + attack against PC Evasion. PCs do not roll defense by default.
Damage uses thresholds. Armor Slots reduce severity by one threshold. If a PC is out of Stress and must mark more, they become Vulnerable and may mark HP.

title: Short Rest, Countdown Die, Ritual Countdown
body: Short rest: each PC chooses two rest moves. The GM gains 1d4 Fear.
Countdowns are visible pressure. Tell players what changes when they tick.
Open Vale uses a ritual countdown. It ticks down when defenders make progress and up when the Custodian is harmed.

title: Conditions
body: Core conditions: Hidden, Restrained, Vulnerable.
Goldspire conditions: Untethered, Audited, Bramble-Snared, Ward-Sick, Compliance-Flagged, Memory-Raw, Debt-Marked.
Describe the fiction first, then name the condition.
